Title: One Fine Day

Cast

1. Kunal - 9 years, son
Look: yellow T-shirt, blue shorts
2. Meenakshi - 35 years, mother
Look: blue saree, hair in a bun
3. Kavya - 13 years, daughter
Look: pink T-shirt, ponytail

Places

1. The courtyard - a brick floor, a tulsi plant

Scene 1: The courtyard - Day

[Kunal stands in the courtyard. Meenakshi and Kavya stand near him.]

Kunal: "Today feels like a good day."

[A dust storm sweeps across the village.]

Kunal (happily): "I knew it!"

[Dry leaves fall from the trees.]

Kunal: "Kavya, listen!"

[Flower petals rain down on Kunal.]

Kavya: "Wow, how lovely!"

[Smoke rises from the chimney.]

Kunal: "Slowly, take it easy."

Scene 2: The courtyard - Night

[Kunal stands in the courtyard. Meenakshi and Kavya stand near him.]

Kavya: "What a nice place."

[A full moon shines in the sky.]

Meenakshi: "Really?"

[Fireflies glow in the dark.]

Meenakshi (softly): "Let's do this again tomorrow!"
